CALL TO ORDER

The Regular Meeting of Public Safety Commission of the City of Artesia was called to
order on April 4, 2023, at the City of Artesia Council Chambers at 6:07 P.M. by
Chairperson Paul De Medeiros.

ROLL CALL

SPECIAL PROCEDURES

NEW BUSINESS

1.  Presentation by the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department Regarding
  Public Safety Activities and Incidents throughout the City of Artesia
   Sgt. Ramos from Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department presented an update

  Commissioner Trerotola asked questions and provided comments.

  Commissioner Nunes asked questions and provided comments.

  Sgt. Ramos provided comments.

  Deputy City Manager Burke provided comments.

  Commissioner Nunes provided comments.

  Commissioner Trerotola asked a question to Sgt. Ramos.

  Sgt. Ramos provided comments and updated the Commission on upcoming
  events.

  MOTION: To Receive and File the Informational Report

  Motion by Vice Chairperson Nunes
  Motion seconded by Commissioner Garcia
  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  Ayes:  Commissioners: Garcia, Trerotola, Nunes, and De Medeiros
  Noes:  Commissioners: None
  Abstain:  Commissioners: None
  Absent:  Commissioners: Rodriquez

2.  Presentation of the Los Angeles County Fire Department Regarding Fire and
  Emergency Medical Service Incidents for the months of October 2022 through

  Department

  Motion by Vice Chairperson Nunes
  Motion seconded by Commissioner Trerotola
  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:
   Ayes:  Commissioners: Garcia, Trerotola, Nunes, and De Medeiros

  Absent:  Commissioners: Rodriquez

3.  Discussion on Upcoming Coffee with the Captain Events

  Deputy City Manager presented a report on the Upcoming Coffee with the Captain

  Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Nunes volunteered to assist staff in the

  MOTION: To Receive and File the Informational Report and Form an Ad-Hoc

  Motion by Chairperson De Medeiros
  Motion seconded by Commissioner Trerotola

  Commissioner Nunes asked questions and provided comments.

  Sgt. Ramos provided comments.

  Commissioner Trerotola asked questions and provided comments.

  Chair De Medeiros provided comments.

  Deputy City Manager Burke provided comments.

   Commissioner Nunes provided comments.

  Deputy City Manager Burke provided comments.

  Commissioner Nunes provided comments.

  Deputy City Manager provided comments.

  Commissioner Nunes provided comments.

  MOTION: To establish a set of priorities for the Safer Neighborhood
  Program that includes enhancing community engagement, increasing
  awareness of wellness activities, and engaging the faith-based community

  Motion by Vice Chairperson Nunes
  Motion seconded by Commissioner Garcia
  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  Ayes:  Commissioners: Garcia, Trerotola, Nunes, and De Medeiros
  Noes:  Commissioners: None
  Abstain:  Commissioners: None
  Absent:  Commissioners: Rodriquez

5.  Discussion on Amending the Regular Meeting Dates of the Public Safety

  Deputy City Manager presented the report on amending the Public Safety

  Vice Chair Nunes provided comments.

  Commissioner Garcia provided comments.

  MOTION: To send a recommendation to the City Council to amend the
  Artesia Municipal Code to change the regular meeting dates of the Public
  Safety Commission to the second Thursday of January, April, July, and

  Motion by Commissioner Garcia
  Motion seconded by Commissioner Vice Chair Nunes
  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:
   Ayes:  Commissioners: Garcia, Trerotola, Nunes, and De Medeiros

  Abstain:  Commissioners: None
  Absent:  Commissioners: Rodriquez

  Deputy City Ma na ger Burke presented the report.

  Vice Cha ir Nunes provided comment.

  MOTION: To cancel the next regularly scheduled meeting for July 4, 2023
  and move the next meeting to July 13.

  Motion by Vice Chairperson Nunes
  Motion seconded by Commissioner Trerotola
  Said motion carried ( 4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

TO:  Public Safety Commission
FROM:  Adrian Fajardo, Management Analyst
  Melissa Burke, Deputy City Manager

SUBJECT:  Follow-up Discussion on Coffee with the Captain Events

BACKGROUND
On the April 4, 2023 Public Safety Commission Meeting, an item was brought before the
Commission to discuss the resumption of the Coffee with the Captain event after a hiatus
due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The Coffee with a Captain events facilitate direct
engagement between the community and law enforcement, promoting transparency,
communication, and collaboration. By request of Commissioner Garcia, further
discussion was desired for the next event.

Key items of discussion include:

  •  Venue selection and time
  •  Promoting awareness
  •  Identifying any key members to attend each event
  •  Capturing feedback from participants

RECOMMENDATION
Staff recommends that the Public Safety Commission discuss upcoming the Coffee with
the Captain event in August and provide direction for future events.

   ITEM 4

  CITY OF ARTESIA

  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION AGENDA REPORT

DATE:  July 13, 2023
TO:  Public Safety Commission
FROM:  Adrian Fajardo, Management Analyst
  Melissa Burke, Deputy City Manager

SUBJECT: Discussion on the creation of a Neighborhood Watch Newsletter

BACKGROUND

On April 4, 2023, the Public Safety Commission directed staff to explore ways to increase
public participation in the Safer Neighborhood Program. During that meeting, a primary
goal was to increase participation in the Neighborhood Watch program. It was recognized
that an effective means of communication and engagement is essential for achieving this
objective. Creating a newsletter would enhance communication, promote community
engagement, and improve safety awareness among Artesia residents.

The newsletter would serve as a valuable resource for disseminating important
information to residents during block captain and Neighborhood Watch meetings. This
initiative aligns with the Safer Neighborhood Program’s vision to strengthen community
bonds, enhance safety awareness, and foster a proactive approach to public safety.

The proposed newsletter would provide highly relevant content by directly addressing
specific concerns or trends in the City. Artesia's SAO team will play a vital role as the
primary source of information. Artesia’s dedicated sergeant possesses a comprehensive
understanding of community activities, crime trends, and safety concerns, making him the
most qualified individual to provide tailored crime prevention strategies and safety tips.
Through close collaboration with the Sergeant, Staff will have access to accurate and up-
to-date data, facilitating the creation of targeted newsletters that address the specific
crimes and incidents occurring in the City. This approach would ensure that the
newsletter's content remains relevant, timely, and impactful.

Components of the Neighborhood Watch Newsletter:

  •  Enhanced Communication: The newsletter would serve as a reliable
  communication channel between law enforcement personnel, block captains, and
  residents.
  •  Crime Prevention and Safety Tips: The newsletter would be an ideal platform to
  share crime prevention strategies, safety tips, and best practices to help residents

  1
   ITEM 4

  protect themselves, their families, and their properties.
  •  Incident Reporting and Updates: The newsletter can include updates on recent
  incidents, crime trends, and law enforcement efforts.
  •  Community Events and Meetings: The newsletter would serve as a central source
  of information regarding upcoming community events, meetings, and training
  sessions.
  •  Emergency Preparedness: The newsletter can include information on emergency
  preparedness, such as creating emergency kits, developing evacuation plans, and
  staying informed during critical situations.
  •  Feedback and Input: The newsletter can provide residents with a platform to
  provide feedback, suggestions, and ideas for improving the Neighborhood Watch
  program or the newsletter itself.

Staff requests the Commission’s guidance and direction in the following areas for the
implementation of a Public Safety Newsletter:

•  Overall Support
•  Content Suggestions
•  Distribution Method, such as an e-newsletter.
•  Timeline and Frequency

RECOMMENDATION
Staff recommends that the Public Safety Commission consider the creation of a
Neighborhood Watch Newsletter and provide direction.
